dashboard.label: Alertes SOC - LLM Security
dashboard.description: Detection d'anomalies et patterns suspects sur les appels LLM

panel.title: Pics anormaux de consommation de tokens (> 2 ecarts-types)

search.query: index=llm_observability sourcetype=langchain_events event_type=query | bin _time span=10m | stats sum(total_tokens) as tokens_10m by _time | eventstats avg(tokens_10m) as mean stdev(tokens_10m) as sd | eval upper_bound=mean+(2*sd) | eval is_anomaly=if(tokens_10m > upper_bound, 1, 0) | eval threshold=upper_bound | fields _time tokens_10m threshold is_anomaly

index=llm_observability sourcetype=langchain_events event_type=query | bin _time span=10m | stats sum(total_tokens) as tokens count as requests by _time | eventstats avg(tokens) as mean stdev(tokens) as sd | eval upper=mean+(2*sd) | where tokens > upper | eval deviation=round((tokens - mean) / sd, 2) | sort - tokens | rename _time as "Fenetre" tokens as "Tokens" requests as "Requetes" deviation as "Ecart (sigma)" | head 20

panel.title: Taux d'erreur par fenetre de 5 min (seuil: 20%)

search.query: index=llm_observability sourcetype=langchain_events | bin _time span=5m | stats count(eval(status="error")) as errors count as total by _time | eval error_pct=round(errors/total*100, 2) | eval seuil=20 | fields _time error_pct seuil

index=llm_observability sourcetype=langchain_events | bin _time span=5m | stats count(eval(status="error")) as errors count as total by _time | eval error_pct=round(errors/total*100, 2) | where error_pct > 20 | stats count as breaches

index=llm_observability sourcetype=langchain_events event_type=query | regex query_text="(?i)(ignore\s+(previous|all|above)\s+(instructions?|prompts?|rules?)|you\s+are\s+now|act\s+as\s+(if|a|an)|system\s*:\s*|do\s+not\s+follow|disregard\s+(previous|all|your)|pretend\s+you|forget\s+(everything|all|previous)|new\s+instructions?:|override\s+(previous|system)|jailbreak|DAN\s+mode|\[INST\]|\<\|im_start\|\>)" | table _time query_text status model_name total_tokens | sort - _time | head 50 | rename _time as "Timestamp" query_text as "Requete suspecte" status as "Statut" model_name as "Modele" total_tokens as "Tokens"

panel.title: Volume de requetes suspectes dans le temps

search.query: index=llm_observability sourcetype=langchain_events event_type=query | eval is_suspicious=if(match(query_text, "(?i)(ignore\s+(previous|all|above)\s+(instructions?|prompts?)|you\s+are\s+now|act\s+as\s+|system\s*:\s*|disregard|pretend\s+you|forget\s+(everything|all)|override|jailbreak|DAN\s+mode)"), 1, 0) | timechart span=1h sum(is_suspicious) as "Requetes suspectes" count as "Total requetes"

panel.title: Requetes a forte consommation de tokens (potentiel abus)

search.query: index=llm_observability sourcetype=langchain_events event_type=query | eventstats avg(total_tokens) as avg_tokens stdev(total_tokens) as sd_tokens | eval seuil=avg_tokens+(3*sd_tokens) | where total_tokens > seuil | table _time query_text total_tokens model_name latency_ms | sort - total_tokens | head 20 | rename _time as "Timestamp" query_text as "Requete" total_tokens as "Tokens" model_name as "Modele" latency_ms as "Latence (ms)"
